newsitem.title: USA: Huntco sees Q3 sales 12 pct below Q2 level.
newsitem.headline: Huntco sees Q3 sales 12 pct below Q2 level.

text.p: Huntco Inc said it expects to report third-quarter sales about 12 percent below the $84 million it reported in its fiscal second quarter.
The company also said it "reconfirmed that its gross profit margins in the third quarter were under pressure because of higher raw material costs."

"The decline in net sales reflects lower sales volume during the November and December holiday periods, when the midweek holidays in 1996 limited the number of shipping days and resulted in lower levels of sales activity," said the intermediate steel processor.
The company also said Thursday it will likely report earnings for the third quarter ending January 31 in the range of $0.01 to $0.03 per share.
The company reported sales of $68.4 million and earnings of $0.24 per share in its third quarter a year ago.
Huntco said it has acquired certain assets of Coil-Tec, a unit of ARBED Americas Inc, part of Arbed SA.
"Huntco believes that this acquisition will be additive to its net income per common share by the first quarter of fiscal 1998," the company said.
The recent sales decline also came on lower sales in November and December as Coil-Tec Inc liquidated much of its hot-rolled steel inventories at two plants.
The company said it expects its net sales for January will recover to record levels near $30 million and that gross profit margins have begun to slowly recover.
